name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
description: Single pan-India emergency number connecting police, fire, health and other emergency services. Also available through the 112 India mobile app.

name: Police
description: Police emergency number. Reported as still active in most states alongside 112.

name: National Ambulance Service
description: National ambulance service number listed in the Government of India directory. Many states also run 108; it is not listed here because it was not confirmed.

name: Women Helpline (WHL-181)
description: Ministry of Women and Child Development helpline for women affected by violence. Connects to police, hospitals, ambulance and legal aid. Integrated with 112 and 1098.

name: Women Helpline (WHL-181): counselling and referral
description: Gives information, psycho-social support and referrals for women affected by violence, including links to support services.

name: Women in Distress Helpline
description: National helpline number for women in distress.

name: National Commission for Women Helpline
description: National Commission for Women helpline listed in the Government of India directory for women facing violence or harassment.

name: CHILDLINE
description: Free national emergency phone service for children in need of care and protection. Integrated with 112.

name: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme)
description: Free national mental health helpline of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, operated by NIMHANS. Counselling, emotional support and referrals in around 20 languages.

name: NALSA Free Legal Services Helpline
description: National Legal Services Authority helpline for free legal advice and legal aid for eligible people, including women and other vulnerable groups.

name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
description: Helpline linked to the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal for reporting online crimes, including financial fraud and online harassment.
